claim: On April 25, 2024, Firewall Manager added network ACL policies, which manage Amazon VPC network ACLs across an organization by enforcing first and last rules in the network ACLs in scope.
question: When did Firewall Manager start to manage network ACLs, and what does a network ACL policy enforce?

evidence.quote: | [AWS Firewall Manager supports network ACL policies](working-with-policies.md) | Firewall Manager now supports the management of Amazon VPC network access control lists (ACLs) through Firewall Manager network ACL policies. | April 25, 2024 |
You can use Firewall Manager network ACL policies to manage Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) network access control lists (ACLs) for your organization in AWS Organizations.
Firewall Manager enforces the presence and ordering of these in the network ACLs that are in scope of the policy, or reports noncompliance.
